status: published; measured data checked in CI by scripts/check_renderer_matrix.py

web.not_supported: the painted check failed (error or broken flag)
web.drawn_with_differences: any of: pixel parity vs React failed (plain pass/fail in deterministic mode, no allowance list); text differs from React; horizontal overflow at 360 px; contrast worse than React in the same environment; behaviour probe differs from React
web.not_verified: no difference found but the atom could not be verified: no visible text, blank on both sides in an environment, or (non-deterministic measurements only) a check recorded as unstable (allowance list). In deterministic mode stability is proven by two identical passes, so nothing is unstable
web.drawn: every check passed (or is not applicable: no probe, behaviour lane not run, not a gate lane, React as reference)
web.not_measured: no example payload for the atom in the gate data

compose.native: the atom's own type is a Basic component and the lane case rendered without error (Compose has no implementation of our atoms)
compose.not_supported: the lane case was rejected: the atom type is not in the Basic catalog
compose.not_measured: no example payload for the atom in the gate data

flutter.native: lane case painted with the atom's own type present
flutter.degraded: lane case lowered to Basic components (own type absent)
flutter.not_measured: invalid_payload (the example is invalid, so the atom itself is untested), or no lane case

dimension: renderer (what draws the atom); separate from x-surfaces (where the atom appears)

status_help.drawn: drawn by the renderer; every check passed
status_help.drawn_with_differences: drawn, but at least one check differs from React (pixels, overflow at 360, contrast or behaviour)
status_help.not_verified: no difference found, but the atom could not be verified (no visible text, blank on both sides, or an unstable check)
status_help.native: drawn by the renderer's own implementation of the atom (Compose: by a Basic component, the atom's root type)
status_help.degraded: drawn through Basic components, not the atom's own implementation
status_help.not_measured: no per-atom data (no example, or the example is invalid)

react.note: The reference renderer: the other web renderers are compared with it pixel for pixel. Its own pixel column is measured against its own frozen reference shots, so parity is recorded as reference, not as a pass.

lit.name: Lit
lit.note: No v1.0 export exists for Lit, so v1.0 was not measured. Dark 360 px is not a gate lane for Lit.

angular.name: Angular
angular.note: Measured against the React lane on the same code.

copilotkit.name: CopilotKit
copilotkit.note: CopilotKit draws our atoms inside ITS wrapper and theme, so the custom-lane numbers measure whether the wrapper changes how our atoms look and behave, not CopilotKit's own components. Primary measurement: version 1.87.0 on A2UI 1.0, our custom lane and four pixel lanes; the behaviour lane was not run for 1.87.0, so behaviour is recorded as not run, never as a pass.
notes_extra: All 670 gate examples render through the A2UI 1.0 path with no validation failure, no unknown component and no crash.

Ten atoms overflow at width in every lane (divider, youtube, image, tabs, audio_player, video_card, info_card, glass_card, hub, content_tabs). The counts on this page cover the public stable atoms only.

Ten atoms now render markdown headings and bold in the stock Text and differ from React for real: body, heading, subheading, video_card, split_pane, numbered_list, columns, info_card, glass_card, hub.

Deterministic: every 1.87.0 shot was taken twice on the shipped build and A equals B (one dither-only exception, gmail_inbox in dark 480), so pixel results are plain pass or fail with no allowance list; the custom text hash is also identical in both passes and agrees with React on 663 of 670 examples (differing: audio_player, body, bullet_list, color_section, numbered_list, quote, video_card). Painting and visible text come from one earlier, non-deterministic CopilotKit 1.87.0 run; the behaviour lane was not run.

Three atoms fail the pixel rule in 1.87.0 only and are unexplained: page_header (all four environments), code_snippet_pair and image_with_caption (480 px, both themes). Content sits 1 px lower than in React and in 1.85.0, identically in both passes; the cause was not isolated. They are shown as drawn with differences, with a note, not hidden.
copilotkit.earlier_measurement: Earlier measurement, CopilotKit 1.85.0 on the v0.9 dialect (same shipped commit): pixel parity with React 593 of 640 non-blank shots (light 480), 627 of 670 (dark 480), 595 of 640 (light 360), 627 of 670 (dark 360); custom text painted 617 of 670. Superseded by 1.87.0; version and dialect changed together, so the two are not a like-for-like comparison.

a2ui-vue.name: a2ui-vue
a2ui-vue.note: a2ui-vue draws our atoms inside ITS wrapper and theme, so the custom-lane numbers measure the wrapper, not a2ui-vue's own components. Vue-only pixel failures were not traced.

flutter.name: Flutter
flutter.note: Partial coverage: only a part of the atoms are ported to native Flutter widgets. Text parity with the web painter was checked on the atoms listed in the parity sweep; the Basic lane was not measured by us; no device run. Measured on a private, unpublished build, after the lane merges.

compose.name: Compose
compose.protocol: v0.9 only (spec v0.9.1; no v1.0 claim)
compose.platform: Compose Desktop on the JVM (Jetpack Compose family); not Android
compose.environment: a2ui-kmp 1.0.0-alpha02 (third-party Kotlin Multiplatform rebuild of Google's androidx.a2ui), Compose Desktop on JVM with Skiko software rendering, measured on the A2UI v0.9.1 dialect; not an Android device; the pixel lane is not meaningful (fonts, Material 3 look)
compose.note: Compose has no implementation of our atoms: every atom whose root is not a Basic component is not supported. Only atoms whose root type is a Basic component (Text, Column, Button, Tabs and so on) draw, through the Basic catalog.
notes_extra: Pixel parity with React is not meaningful here (different fonts, Material 3 look), so the pixel lane is recorded for information and never decides a status.
